title: AWS Hybrid Connectivity: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Your office needs a link to the cloud. There are different delivery services to choose from. Picking the right one depends on speed, cost and time.

scenes.heading: Three delivery services
scenes.narration: Each option suits a different need. A Site to Site V P N is encrypted, over the public internet. Direct Connect is a private dedicated cable to the cloud. Direct Connect takes weeks to set up, but is steadier. Many firms run a V P N as a backup for Direct Connect.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. Direct Connect is more consistent. It isn't encrypted by default. It can take weeks.

items.wrong: Direct Connect is encrypted by default
Direct Connect is quick to order

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva AWS hybrid lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. V P N is quick and cheap. Direct Connect is dedicated and steady. Use a V P N as backup. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva AWS hybrid lab.
